```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
lead_data = read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
gt(head(lead_data))
```

The above table shows the number of cases of children between the age of 0 and 15 who were reported to have elevated levels of the toxic heavy metal lead in their blood. The data covers the years 2015-2024.
